title: The Hand Upon the Wall
traveler_why: Daniel told the plain truth without wanting a prize, and quiet, pondering truth is Wren's way.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because Daniel told the plain truth without wanting a prize, and quiet truth is Wren’s way. In Wren’s world today: Wren knocks over the crayon cup, and her friend gets blamed. Wren’s tummy goes tight. She walks over, tells the truth, “It was me,” and helps pick up every crayon. Just like Daniel telling the truth without wanting the king’s gifts, Wren learned that telling the truth is right, even with no reward.
